# Muhammad Haziq

> Muhammad Haziq is a Senior Full-Stack Software Engineer based in Dubai, UAE, with 7+ years of experience building web applications, fintech platforms, payment integrations and agentic AI with Claude AI, using Node.js, NestJS, TypeScript, React and Next.js. He works remotely with clients in the USA, UK, UAE, Saudi Arabia, Europe and Canada, and is available for web application projects, remote contracts and technical consulting.

- Current role: Senior Software Engineer at InsuranceMarket.ae (Dubai, 2023 – present), leading backend engineering, insurance plan creation with providers such as GIG and Liva, payment integrations (Apple Pay, Checkout.com, TAP) and agentic AI development with Claude AI.
